title: Sovereign Operator I
subtitle: Portable Agents field course — offline-first inference and agent ops on the Black Cloud Node.

steps.title: Orient on the stack
steps.body: You are at the entry point of the sovereign path. Mission Control is the pane of glass; the Black Cloud Node is the body you carry. NEEDLE keeps your bearing toward the next checkpoint while you move in first-person — not across a timeline.

steps.title: Validate air-gap mode
steps.body: Cut outbound network paths and confirm the agent loop still closes on local weights. Rwanda’s requirement is bare metal, on-premise, fully offline — this checkpoint is the proof.

steps.title: LiteLLM gateway at :4000
steps.body: Route Qwen, DeepSeek, and Llama through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint on the device. Portable agents never hard-code vendor URLs; they speak to the local gateway.

steps.title: Deploy the six-agent fleet
steps.body: NALEDI-CEO signs; SCHALK owns channel; JENSEN owns compute; KIGALI owns corridors; CASHCLAW models; RALF coordinates. Each agent has a lane — no overlap on deals.

steps.title: Calibrate NEEDLE navigation
steps.body: NEEDLE is the compass UI for this course: it reads bearing from the path ahead and keeps the operator oriented forward through checkpoints instead of panning a left-to-right map.

steps.title: Ministerial handoff package
steps.body: Export the module catalog, offline stack image, and this POV course as the UNDP-vettable pilot artefact. One or two concrete things — specified tightly enough to survive review.
